newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen falling, yen to be a factor.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen falling, yen to be a factor.

text.p: Seoul stocks are expected to fall on Thursday but a further rise in Japanese yen will likely spark a rebound, brokers said.
They said jitters about a possible institutional selling in connection with futures settlement would continue to depress large-capitalised stocks.
On Wednesday the composite index ended 4.04 points lower at 765.79.
"The yen's further rise is expected to boost buying in shipbuilding and export manufacturers," said Chung Chang-shik of Dongsuh Securities.
